name: Omasend
author: Gavin Nugent
description: LocalSend-compatible file transfer and messaging, native to the shell: discover devices on the LAN or tailnet, send files and messages, and receive them whenever the shell is running — no app open required. Summon with: omarchy-shell shell toggle nosignal.omasend

barWidget.description: Bar icon that toggles the Omasend panel; badges on unread messages and active transfers
